title: Portfolio Open Graph and social-sharing continuity
intent: Make every shared portfolio link carry the current public identity, current page metadata, and a governed photographic card without allowing social previews to drift from the site or expand publication rights.

criteria.criterion: The homepage and social card consume one canonical name, role, and tagline rather than maintaining duplicated copy.
Jamie's name uses the same TeX Gyre Pagella identity face on the site and in the rendered social card, with zero letter spacing and a revisioned preview URL.
The role, tagline, site address, photo label, and photographer credit remain in Karla so the identity serif does not spread beyond Jamie's name.

The identity face and supporting Karla interface face are delivered from versioned local font assets with upstream records, public licenses, and recorded checksums; no system or resume-embedded proprietary font is republished.
Every route produced by createMetadata carries its current title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph URL, and matching Twitter title and description.
Open Graph and Twitter use the same absolute, revisioned 1200 by 630 image URL, and Twitter declares summary_large_image so a new card revision can invalidate stale platform previews.
The card uses a metadata-stripped full-frame East River derivative through an explicit social-card placement and Knowledge Wiki projection.
The East River derivative is displayed full-frame without a new crop, and the rendered card visibly credits Elana Gordon.
The Open Graph image has useful alternative text that describes Jamie, the visible public setting, and his current role family.
Public Git and staging approval do not imply production, indexing, a standalone social-media license, or unrestricted reuse of the photograph.
